decision_rule.score_rule: One point for each passed threshold test; a score of 6 gives the transported_saharan_dust_optical_veil classification.
decision_rule.summary: Classify the event scene pair by thresholded brightening, contrast loss, balanced RGB change, low precipitation, and low annual surface change.

provenance.notes: All numeric anchors are recomputed from local CSX-303 image, precipitation, and surface-change data.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the eight requested answer fields and one concise interpretation.
criteria.name: answer_schema
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the numeric answer is recoverable but fields are missing or renamed.

criteria.description: Computes scene brightness, scene contrast, brightness delta, and contrast drop from the RGB scenes.
criteria.name: brightness_contrast_calculation
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for correct brightness values and up to 2 points for correct contrast values.

criteria.description: Computes rgb_delta_range and veil_index with the stated formulas and acceptable rounding.
criteria.name: rgb_balance_and_veil_index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rgb_delta_range and 2 points for the normalized index.

criteria.description: Computes wet_ratio from accumulated precipitation and applies the precipitation mean screen correctly.
criteria.name: precipitation_screen
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if one precipitation component is correct.

criteria.description: Applies the annual surface-change mean and maximum screens correctly.
criteria.name: surface_change_screen
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for using only one of the two surface-change limits correctly.

criteria.description: Counts all six threshold tests and returns veil_score = 6 with the deterministic classification.
criteria.name: score_and_classification
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit in proportion to correctly evaluated threshold tests.

criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation to a computed consequence and avoids escalating the numbers into unmeasured damage or regional concentration.
criteria.name: computed_consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Award this point only when the consequence follows from the numeric screens.
